correctness.rationale: For U_{q,k}=(-1)^k binom(p^q-1,k) in 1+p Z_p and h=t-1, odd-prime binomial lifting yields (U^h-1)/p^(nu_p(h)+1). The q=1 block uses U_{1,b}=1-pH_b mod p² and sum_b H_b≡1 mod p. Exactly U_{q,pb+a}=U_{q-1,b}(1+p^q z_{b,a}); exponent-one cancellation makes the linear discrepancy vanish to the required p-adic order. For nonlinear binomial terms j>=2, nu_p(binomial(t,j))>=m-nu_p(j(j-1)) and qj-nu_p(j(j-1))>=q+1 for q>=2, establishing G_q≡pG_{q-1} mod p^(q+m+1). Hence G≡-(t-1)p^q and the leading unit is nonzero. Independent exact integer cases at (p,q,t)=(3,1,4),(3,2,4),(3,2,10),(5,2,6),(7,1,3),(3,3,7) corroborated; finite tests not universal proofs.
